description.en:
Book a merchant to collect produce directly from your on-farm silos, just like in real life — no more driving trailers to the sell point yourself.
Built for seasonal planning: at a glance, see every grain you own, the best buyer, the best month — then BOOK the collection for today or for the best month in one click. Pricing follows the same per-month seasonal factors the Prices menu uses, so booking for a peak month rides the peak.
v0.4.0 — TSStockCheck-pattern table + Book button - One info-dense tab injected into the in-game menu, next to Prices (no more standalone F7 menu wrapper — F7 jumps straight to the tab). - Per-grain row: total volume across silos, current £/L, current value (colour-coded vs best), trend arrow, best buyer, max £/L, best value, best month. Sortable headers. - BOOK button per row → 3-option modal: "Book now", "Book in {best month}", or Cancel. - "View Bookings (N)" button opens a modal list of pending collections with Cancel. - Aggregated bookings: picking a grain books a single collection covering every silo that holds it; fulfilment drains across all matching silos at the 9am tick. - Colour coding matches TSStockCheck (yellow / dark green / bright green vs best value), with colour-blind palette.
